title: Decide public product and package identity before external distribution
description: Decide whether "Loreweaver" remains an internal codename or becomes the public product/package identity. Evaluate brand collision risk, domain availability, npm/GitHub namespace availability, and the implications for package names, CLI names, and documentation.
acceptance_criteria: A public identity decision is recorded. The decision states whether Loreweaver remains the public name or is retained as an internal codename only. It identifies the intended npm scope/package namespace, CLI binary name, GitHub/project naming implications, and any follow-up rename work needed before public distribution.
notes: Public identity is now Eshyra. Package names are @eshyra/* and the CLI binary/package naming is eshyra. The repo rename has been applied mechanically; this decision supersedes the old Loreweaver public-identity framing.
close_reason: Public identity recorded as Eshyra; package and CLI naming updated to @eshyra/* and eshyra.
